articles.title: Analytics: add provider
articles.summary: Explains how to add a new analytics destination from the Integrations Analytics area. It covers opening the provider picker, selecting tools such as Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog, custom scripts, or server-side destinations, then publishing and verifying events.

articles.title: Analytics integration list
articles.summary: Explains how to review the Analytics integrations list before launch. It covers checking which destinations are enabled, removing stale tracking IDs, understanding that enabled integrations inject into published web funnels, and enabling Segmently first-party analytics for internal reports and canvas insights.

articles.title: Analytics provider configuration
articles.summary: Explains provider-specific analytics configuration fields and validation. It covers integration names, GA4 Measurement IDs, GTM Container IDs, Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog, Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, custom HEAD or BODY scripts, server-side Conversions API style destinations, and how to verify events after saving.

articles.title: V2 canvas: add screen
articles.summary: Shows how to add a V2 screen from the Screen Templates panel, search for the right question, content, embed, or paywall template, drag it onto the canvas, and open the new node for section editing. Use this when a customer needs another step in an onboarding flow.

articles.title: V2 canvas: connect screens
articles.summary: Explains how to connect V2 onboarding screens so every action reaches the intended next step. It covers default paths, conditional branches, checking incoming and outgoing connections, and validating that the launch route does not leave visitors at a dead end.

articles.title: V2 canvas overview
articles.summary: Explains how to read a V2 onboarding canvas before publication: identify the launch screen, follow the visitor route, inspect branches, and confirm paywall screens point to valid products. Use this for a high-level canvas health and launch-readiness review.

articles.title: Collect the customer email before the paywall (required for subscriptions)
articles.summary: Explains why a paid subscription funnel must collect the visitor email before the paywall and how that email supports Stripe subscriptions, customer identity, receipts, attribution, and later billing support. Use this for questions about email capture before checkout, subscription readiness, and metadata needed before showing a paywall.

articles.title: Custom Domain: DNS setup
articles.summary: Explains how to add the exact DNS records Segmently provides for a custom domain, keep the records DNS-only without a proxy, and wait for propagation before verification. Use this when the branded funnel hostname is entered but its DNS is not ready.

articles.title: Custom Domain: domain input
articles.summary: Explains how to enter the exact public hostname for a Segmently custom domain without a protocol, port, or path, and confirm that the customer can edit its DNS. Use this when validating the domain value before records are generated.

articles.title: Custom Domain: verification
articles.summary: Explains how to verify a Segmently custom domain after DNS records propagate, retry verification safely, and confirm the branded hostname is ready before publication. Use this when DNS was added but the domain still shows a pending or failed state.

articles.title: Send Facebook (CAPI) events from your web funnel
articles.summary: Shows how to turn on Facebook Conversions API (CAPI) event forwarding for a web funnel: open the Edit Web Funnel dialog, and in the Destinations section click the one-click + Facebook CAPI button, which adds the visitor IP, user agent, and Facebook _fbp and _fbc cookies to both Server Data and Stripe Metadata, then publish. Use this when a customer asks…

articles.title: Every event Segmently sends to Facebook (Pixel + Conversions API)
articles.summary: Lists the Facebook Pixel and Conversions API events that Segmently can send from a funnel, including page visits, onboarding interactions, product catalog selection, checkout, and purchase-related signals. Use this when customers ask what Facebook or Meta events are emitted, which parameters are included, or how the event catalog relates to attribution and…

articles.title: Set up the Facebook (Meta) Pixel and Conversion API
articles.summary: Shows how to connect Facebook or Meta analytics to Segmently by adding the Pixel ID and Conversions API token, then verifying that funnel events can be sent to Meta. Use this for setup questions about Facebook Pixel, Meta Pixel, CAPI, access tokens, provider configuration, and event tracking readiness.

articles.title: Action Bar — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the Action Bar section that controls the screen's primary and secondary call-to-action buttons. It covers button labels, text styles, fill and border styling, gradients, shadows, effects, icons, spacing, and which screens use the shared bottom button bar, including WebEmbed and ordinary onboarding screens.

articles.title: Background
articles.summary: Explains the Background section used across screen types to set the full-screen backdrop behind content. It covers solid color, photo, video, browser chrome color, visual contrast, and where background controls appear on regular screens, WebEmbed, Paywall, and Flexible Layout screens.

articles.title: Basic Config — all settings
articles.summary: Documents screen-level Basic Config controls that change runtime behavior rather than visible content. It covers entrance animation, offline or cached media, device permission prompts, auto-advance countdown timing, and the screen types where these settings are available.

articles.title: Carousel — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the Carousel screen section for timed slide-based storytelling. It covers slide template, slide title, subtitle, detail text, slide images, per-slide timing, total duration, image and text layout regions, container styling, and text/image appearance controls.

articles.title: Content — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the shared Content section for screen title, subtitle, and hero image elements. It covers copy values, text styles, hero image source and sizing, spacing around content, layout choices, and how Content appears across hero, list, grid, text input, wheel picker, and hero list screens.

articles.title: Custom HTML — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the Custom HTML or WebEmbed section for embedding custom iframe or HTML experiences inside a Segmently screen. It covers the code editor, Apply to Preview, iframe isolation and sandbox settings, external data sources, and boundaries between WebEmbed paywalls, analytics scripts, and custom domain setup.

articles.title: Flexible Sections — all settings
articles.summary: Documents Flexible Layout sections and their layout, content, and management settings. It covers adding, deleting, reordering, naming, scrolling, sizing, alignment, background, borders, z-index, and the linked Product Catalog paywall pattern where Text and Purchase Button sections read the selected product description and purchase label.

articles.title: Header — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the Header section at the top of onboarding screens. It covers Back and Skip buttons, progress indicators, header layout and height, button labels, button text and icon styling, progress colors, insets, background, and screen types where the header appears.

articles.title: Media — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the shared Media section for image and video content on list, grid, wheel picker, and other supported screens. It covers media kind, uploaded images, video source, sizing, fit, alignment, corner radius, repeat behavior, and when paywall-specific media uses a separate guide.

articles.title: Options — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the Options section for list, grid, and hero-list choice screens. It covers answer items, labels, stored values, selection mode, max selections, random order, list or grid layout, checkbox style, item spacing, padding, images, selected state, and option text/container appearance.

articles.title: Paywall Body — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the Paywall Body section that carries the main selling copy below the paywall header. It covers headline and subtitle text, benefit bullet items, benefit icons or images, benefit list layout, text styles, spacing, and how body copy supports conversion before purchase.

articles.title: Paywall Footer — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the Paywall Footer section that sits near the purchase area. It covers purchase button copy, auto-renewal disclosure, restore purchases, terms and privacy links, legal URLs, footer element order, legal-link styling, and compliance copy around checkout.

articles.title: Paywall Header — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the Paywall Header section at the top of a paywall screen. It covers close and restore controls, badges or introductory labels, header text and layout, restore styling, delayed close behavior, and how the header frames the paid offer before the body and subscription choices.

articles.title: Paywall Media — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the Paywall Media section for visual proof or product imagery on a paywall. It covers image or video media, upload/source choices, sizing, fit, placement, and how paywall media differs from generic screen media when building subscription or paid access screens.

articles.title: Paywall Subscriptions — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the Paywall Subscriptions section where products, offers, prices, and subscription choices are shown on a paywall. It covers linked Stripe products, product catalog items, selection state, item labels, pricing text, subscription options, layout, styling, and ordinary paywall purchase behavior.

articles.title: Roller — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the Roller section used by Wheel Picker screens. It covers wheel labels, item appearance, selected value styling, roller container layout, thickness, spacing, and how roller choices connect to variables and screen progression.

articles.title: Stepper — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the Stepper section for Progress Steps screens. It covers auto-advancing step segments, total duration, segment timing, progress fill and track styling, media/text layout, step titles, subtitles, images, and visual timing for onboarding progress sequences.

articles.title: Sticky Container — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the Sticky Container section for Flexible Layout screens. It covers pinned or sticky content, section positioning, layout behavior while other flexible sections scroll, and how sticky controls can support persistent calls to action or navigation in a flexible screen.

articles.title: Text Field — all settings
articles.summary: Documents the Text Field section for Text Input screens. It covers placeholder text, input styling, borders, keyboard/input behavior, validation-oriented appearance, and how entered text can be captured through variables or used before later funnel steps.

articles.title: Variable Binding — all settings
articles.summary: Documents Variable Binding settings that connect a screen's user choice or text input to a saved variable. It covers variable name, value mapping, option stored values, score effects, binding options, and how later screens, conditions, analytics, or checkout metadata can use captured answers.

articles.title: Content — Hero Content
articles.summary: Explains the Content section for Hero Content screens, focusing on the main headline, supporting subtitle, and optional hero image that introduce the funnel. Use it for questions about editing hero screen copy, lead visuals, and first-screen presentation.

articles.title: Content — Wheel Picker & Hero List screens
articles.summary: Explains the Content section variant used by Wheel Picker and Hero List screens. It covers the title, subtitle, and hero image elements that frame a wheel or hero-list choice experience before the visitor interacts with the main selection control.

articles.title: Content — list, grid & text screens
articles.summary: Explains the Content section variant for list, grid, and text-input screens. It covers title and subtitle copy used to ask the question or prompt the visitor, plus supporting content layout that sits above options, grid items, or a text field.

articles.title: Hero image — element guide
articles.summary: Element-level guide for the hero image inside Content sections. It covers image source, dimensions, fit, rounding, spacing, and how the lead visual works with title and subtitle copy across hero, list, grid, wheel picker, and hero list screens.

articles.title: Subtitle — element guide
articles.summary: Element-level guide for subtitle text inside Content sections. It covers editing the supporting line under the title, typography, color, alignment, spacing, and how subtitles clarify a question, offer, or instruction without becoming the primary headline.

articles.title: Title — element guide
articles.summary: Element-level guide for title text inside Content sections. It covers editing the main headline or question, typography, color, alignment, spacing, and how title copy acts as the first line a visitor reads on content-driven screens.

articles.title: Add and configure Button sections in Flexible Layout
articles.summary: Explains how to add and configure a regular Flexible Layout Button section, including its localized label, typography, fill, borders, gradient, shadow, icon, padding, and navigation action.

articles.title: Add and configure Media sections in Flexible Layout
articles.summary: Explains how to add and configure image or video Media sections in Flexible Layout, including scale mode, relative height, corners, alignment, video repeat, and readability gradients.

articles.title: Add a Purchase Button to a Flexible Layout paywall
articles.summary: Explains how a Flexible Layout Purchase Button links to Product Catalog, uses selected-product labels, starts the correct checkout, handles cancellation/downsale, and is verified with payment_intent or setup_intent evidence.

articles.title: Add and style Text sections in Flexible Layout
articles.summary: Explains how to add, write, translate, personalize, and style Text sections inside a Flexible Layout screen, including product-aware label fallback through a linked Product Catalog.

articles.title: Fonts — set your funnel typography
articles.summary: Explains how to set a web funnel's typography from the Integrations → Font Mappings panel: pick one of Segmently's built-in web fonts per platform, or use the All platforms column to apply one font everywhere so the funnel renders identically on every device, and upload your own brand font (TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2 up to 5 MB) after confirming a…

articles.title: Options — Grid Multi Pick
articles.summary: Explains the Options section for Grid Multi Pick screens, where visitors can select more than one choice from a grid. It covers grid item labels, images, selected state, multi-select behavior, stored values, checkbox or selection affordances, and grid layout.

articles.title: Options — Grid Single Pick
articles.summary: Explains the Options section for Grid Single Pick screens, where visitors choose one item from a grid. It covers item labels, images, selected state, stored values, grid spacing, and single-selection behavior used for product, preference, or segmentation choices.

articles.title: Options — Hero List
articles.summary: Explains the Options section for Hero List screens, combining prominent list choices with hero-style presentation. It covers item labels, descriptions or images where available, selected state, stored values, and layout choices for a visually rich selection screen.

articles.title: Options — List Multi Pick
articles.summary: Explains the Options section for List Multi Pick screens, where visitors can select multiple answers from a vertical list. It covers list item labels, selected state, checkbox behavior, maximum selections, random order, stored values, and list spacing.

articles.title: Options — List Single Pick
articles.summary: Explains the Options section for List Single Pick screens, where visitors choose one answer from a vertical list. It covers item labels, selected state, stored values, list item layout, spacing, and single-selection behavior for segmentation or preference questions.

articles.title: Carousel screen
articles.summary: Screen overview for Carousel screens, showing the sections that make up a timed slide deck and linking to the full Carousel and Header or Background guides. Use it to understand which editor sections control carousel slides, timing, images, and surrounding screen chrome.

articles.title: Flexible Layout screen
articles.summary: Screen overview for Flexible Layout screens, showing the flexible sections, background, sticky container, and linked Product Catalog patterns available on this screen type. Use it for questions about building custom layouts, WebEmbedded-like compositions, flexible paywalls, and product-linked labels or purchase buttons.

articles.title: Grid Multi Pick screen
articles.summary: Screen overview for Grid Multi Pick screens, showing the sections used to ask a question and let visitors select multiple grid items. It links to Content, Options, Media, Variable Binding, Action Bar, Header, Background, and Basic Config guides.

articles.title: Grid Single Pick screen
articles.summary: Screen overview for Grid Single Pick screens, showing the sections used to ask a question and let visitors choose one grid item. It links to Content, Options, Media, Variable Binding, Action Bar, Header, Background, and Basic Config guides.

articles.title: Hero Content screen
articles.summary: Screen overview for Hero Content screens, showing the sections used to create a simple branded intro or value-proposition screen. It links to Header, Content, Action Bar, Background, and Basic Config settings that shape the first impression of a funnel.

articles.title: Hero Content screen
articles.summary: Detailed Hero Content screen guide that explains how the intro screen is assembled from title, subtitle, hero image, action buttons, header, background, and behavior settings. Use it when the customer needs a fuller explanation of all Hero Content screen parts.

articles.title: Hero Content screen
articles.summary: Element-oriented Hero Content screen overview, mapping the visible title, subtitle, hero image, action bar, header, background, and basic behavior controls to their full guides. Use it for questions that name a visible element on a hero screen.

articles.title: Hero List screen
articles.summary: Screen overview for Hero List screens, showing the content and options structure for a visually rich list selection experience. It links to Header, Content, Options, Variable Binding, Action Bar, Background, and Basic Config guides.

articles.title: List Multi Pick screen
articles.summary: Screen overview for List Multi Pick screens, showing the sections used to ask a question and let visitors select multiple list answers. It links to Content, Options, Media, Variable Binding, Action Bar, Header, Background, and Basic Config guides.

articles.title: List Single Pick screen
articles.summary: Screen overview for List Single Pick screens, showing the sections used to ask a question and let visitors choose one list answer. It links to Content, Options, Media, Variable Binding, Action Bar, Header, Background, and Basic Config guides.

articles.title: Paywall screen
articles.summary: Screen overview for Paywall screens, showing how paywall header, media, body, subscription products, footer, background, and basic behavior work together. Use it to explain ordinary paywalls, Stripe-linked products, subscription choices, purchase copy, restore/legal controls, and where each paywall setting lives.

articles.title: Progress Steps screen
articles.summary: Screen overview for Progress Steps screens, showing the Header and Stepper sections used to present an auto-advancing progress sequence. Use it for questions about progress bars, timed steps, segment labels, step images, and screen-level navigation controls.

articles.title: Text Input screen
articles.summary: Screen overview for Text Input screens, showing the sections used to ask for freeform text and continue the funnel. It links to Header, Content, Text Field, Variable Binding, Action Bar, Background, and Basic Config guides.

articles.title: Web Embed screen
articles.summary: Screen overview for Web Embed screens, showing how Custom HTML, Action Bar, Header, Background, and Basic Config sections combine to host an embedded external or custom experience. Use it for WebEmbed setup, iframe/code questions, and distinguishing WebEmbed screens from Flexible Layout compositions.

articles.title: Wheel Picker screen
articles.summary: Screen overview for Wheel Picker screens, showing the sections used for a scrollable wheel selection experience. It links to Header, Content, Media, Roller, Variable Binding, Action Bar, Background, and Basic Config guides.

articles.title: Keep your strategy and onboarding funnel in sync
articles.summary: Explains how a strategy and its linked onboarding funnel stay synchronized through Compile, Push, block-level Pull, and Lift. It covers preview-first plans, three-way screen conflicts, variable resolutions, preserving funnel edits, and placing loose screens back into strategy blocks.

articles.title: Analytics setup
articles.summary: Explains the Analytics setup section in Integrations and why tracking should be configured before sending traffic. It covers choosing the correct analytics destination, verifying that visits, screen events, checkout transitions, and purchase signals arrive, and optionally enabling GDPR consent controls before publishing a funnel.

articles.title: Custom Domain setup
articles.summary: Explains the Custom Domain setup flow for replacing a generic Segmently link with a branded domain. It covers the order of entering the domain, adding DNS records at the customer's domain provider, verifying the domain in Segmently, and publishing only after the domain is ready.

articles.title: Stripe Connect setup
articles.summary: Explains where Stripe Connect lives in Integrations and why the correct Stripe account mode must be connected before Segmently can map paywall products to Stripe products and prices. Use this when product lookup or checkout setup is blocked by a missing connection.

articles.title: Launch a paid funnel you can run ads against: the complete order of steps
articles.summary: Gives the recommended end-to-end order for launching a paid funnel that can receive ad traffic. It covers setup dependencies such as Stripe, paywall products, analytics, onboarding screens, web placement or URL routing, publish verification, and how to avoid skipping payment or tracking prerequisites.

articles.title: Create an onboarding
articles.summary: Shows how to start one new V2 onboarding draft from the onboarding list, choose the creation flow, and avoid duplicate drafts for the same campaign. Use this when a customer is ready to create the funnel container before adding screens.

articles.title: Onboarding wizard: basic information
articles.summary: Explains the onboarding wizard's basic information step where the customer sets the funnel name, target platform, and language. It clarifies that the platform choice affects the publication surface and runtime behavior, so these fields should be correct before design begins.

articles.title: Onboarding wizard: theme customization
articles.summary: Explains how to customize high-level theme settings during onboarding creation while leaving screen-specific copy and layout for the Screen Editor. Use this to establish shared colors, typography, and styling without prematurely editing individual screens.

articles.title: Onboarding wizard: theme selection
articles.summary: Shows how to choose a theme in the onboarding creation wizard and check that it supports every planned screen type, not only the first screen. Use this when customers want a consistent visual baseline before they start editing individual screens.

articles.title: Payment methods on your paywall: embedded vs redirect, cards & wallets
articles.summary: Explains payment method behavior on Segmently paywalls, including embedded checkout versus redirect-style checkout, card payments, Apple Pay or wallet availability, Stripe configuration dependencies, and how payment method choices relate to the paywall purchase experience.

articles.title: Paywall Product: basic fields
articles.summary: Explains the basic Paywall Product fields for the offer name, product type, and checkout behavior. Use this when a product is being created and must display correctly on the paywall and produce the intended Stripe checkout flow.

articles.title: Paywall Product: price setup
articles.summary: Explains how to set a Paywall Product amount, currency, and recurrence so the displayed offer matches what Stripe will charge. Use this to prevent pricing mismatches between the paywall copy, Segmently product record, and checkout session.

articles.title: Paywall Product: Stripe mapping
articles.summary: Explains how to map a Segmently Paywall Product to the intended Stripe product and price in the same Test or Live account mode. Use this when checkout must charge the exact catalog item and amount selected during product setup.

articles.title: Paywall Product: subscription options
articles.summary: Explains Paywall Product subscription settings such as billing interval and trial so they match the mapped Stripe price and the offer shown on the paywall. Use this when recurring billing behavior or trial copy is inconsistent.

articles.title: Paywall Products list
articles.summary: Explains the Paywall Products list where products are created and reviewed before being attached to a paywall screen. It covers matching products to the connected Stripe Test or Live mode and checking that the intended product is available for checkout.

articles.title: Paywall Products mode tabs
articles.summary: Explains the Test and Live tabs in Paywall Products and why the selected tab must match both the connected Stripe mode and the funnel being published. Use this to diagnose missing products or checkout mode mismatches.

articles.title: Screen Editor action button
articles.summary: Explains how to configure a screen's action button label and behavior so visitors understand the next step and the button follows the canvas transition. It also covers keeping required inputs blocking until the screen has a valid answer.

articles.title: Screen Editor overview
articles.summary: Introduces the Screen Editor as the place to configure one screen's copy, layout, media, variables, actions, background, and behavior. It distinguishes shared sections from screen-specific sections and helps customers find the correct control before making changes.

articles.title: Stripe Connect: live mode
articles.summary: Explains when and how to connect Stripe Live mode to the production Stripe account after real products, prices, payout details, and business readiness are confirmed. Use this before publishing a funnel that will charge actual customers.

articles.title: Stripe Connect: OAuth guidance
articles.summary: Explains the Stripe OAuth handoff and why the customer must authorize the correct Test or Live account mode. It covers selecting the intended Stripe account so product and price lookup, checkout creation, and later verification use the same environment.

articles.title: Stripe Connect: test mode
articles.summary: Explains how to connect Stripe Test mode first so a paywall and checkout can be exercised without charging real customers. Use it to validate product mappings, prices, subscriptions, and purchase behavior before moving the funnel to Live mode.

articles.title: Every event Segmently sends to TikTok (Pixel + Events API)
articles.summary: Lists the TikTok Pixel and Events API events that Segmently can send from a funnel, including visitor activity, onboarding interactions, product catalog selection, checkout, and purchase-related signals. Use this when customers ask what TikTok events are emitted or how TikTok tracking maps to funnel behavior.

articles.title: Set up the TikTok Pixel and Events API
articles.summary: Shows how to connect TikTok analytics to Segmently by configuring the TikTok Pixel and Events API credentials, then verifying that funnel events can be sent. Use this for setup questions about TikTok Pixel, Events API tokens, provider configuration, and analytics readiness.

articles.title: Web Placement entry rules
articles.summary: Explains Web Placement entry rules that choose the first screen from a source or routing value. It covers defining specific routes, keeping a valid default entry path, and verifying every visitor can enter the published onboarding even when no source rule matches.

articles.title: Web Placement publish URL
articles.summary: Explains how to publish a Web Placement, copy its public URL, and smoke-test the entire funnel in a clean session before sending traffic. It includes checking navigation, checkout, analytics, and the final custom-domain or Segmently serving URL.

articles.title: Web Placement Stripe metadata
articles.summary: Explains how Web Placement metadata mappings pass stable funnel values such as customer email and UTM attribution into Stripe checkout and webhooks. Use this when downstream billing records need reliable context from the published visitor session.
